supersedes.reason: v3 retained every request and attempt, left numeric conventions underspecified, trusted self-attested metrics, and could not identify area scaling; no outcomes existed

seed_schedule.selection_rule: one seed for masked, tied, non-interior, and coincident cells; 5000 fixed seeds for every otherwise-supported interior cell including disjoint geometries
seed_schedule.precision: at p=0.95, binomial standard error is 0.00308 and the frozen absolute tolerance 0.02 is 6.49 standard errors

matrix_contract.pairwise_level_coverage: every level combination for every pair of the nine axes appears at least once

execution_protocol.regeneration: derive every request, full raw DGP, and latent noiseless target/reference histories from preregistration_sha256, cell_id, and seed_index
execution_protocol.commit_rule: each cell summary atomically commits after exact regenerated request order, raw DGP and latent-history comparison, estimator/covariance validation, online reduction, attempt digest, count, and scope validation; shard manifest commits only after its exact scheduled cell set
execution_protocol.resume_rule: reuse requires Rust spatial_covariance_batch replay from seed zero and exact regenerated attempt digest plus byte-identical independently recomputed summary; without that executable the cell is not reusable
execution_protocol.manifest_read: read bounded bytes once with pre/open/post identity checks, then hash and parse those same bytes
execution_protocol.malformed_record_rule: fail current cell without commit; previously committed cells remain reusable only after exact replay

determinism.seed_preimage: ASCII validation_seed + ASCII || + UTF-8 cell_id + ASCII || + unsigned seed_index canonical base-10 without leading zeros + ASCII || + signed source_row canonical base-10 + ASCII , + signed source_column canonical base-10; global source-process stream uses literal global-source-process
determinism.uniform: take successive uint64_be words u; mantissa=u>>11; (mantissa+0.5)/2^53 in open interval (0,1)
determinism.normal_transform: Box-Muller pairs z0=sqrt(-2*ln(u0))*cos(2*pi*u1), z1=sqrt(-2*ln(u0))*sin(2*pi*u1); IEEE-754 binary64 operations in written order; pi=0x1.921fb54442d18p+1
determinism.complex_normal: temporal AR(1) proper-complex signal plus independent proper-complex noise; spatial stress mixes local and global innovations with sqrt(0.5) weights
determinism.complex_storage: round each generated real and imaginary component to IEEE-754 binary32, then promote exactly to binary64 for support selection and streaming hashes
determinism.matrix_order: source coordinates row-major, acquisition ascending, component real then imag; estimate histories target then reference; covariance and online reductions row-major; no fused reassociation
determinism.numeric_encoding: raw source hashes use domain tag, uint64 source count, int64_be row/column, uint64 acquisition count, then finite binary64 real/imag; history and covariance hashes use domain tag then uint64 element count and finite binary64 row-major; negative zero canonicalized positive; NaN and infinity prohibited

numeric_contract.raw_dgp: regenerate every complex look over the realized full target/reference support union and complete acquisition topology, including signed global innovation loadings; compare exact shape, scalar count, union/target/reference content hashes, support hashes, ancestry hash, DGP identity, and target/reference loading means before scoring
numeric_contract.latent_truth: regenerate noiseless target and reference phase histories from slope_rad_per_day plus signed 0.0002*sin((2*row-column)/11) radians/day, cadence, coordinates, and exact acquisition-zero gauge; coincident coordinates share one identical history
numeric_contract.estimator_evidence: Rust emits actual EMI or EVD target/reference date histories, predicted production target-minus-reference date covariance, bounded 2N by 2N production joint operator and dense-oracle matrices, exact final-date target-minus-reference contrast weights, and HDF5 v4 artifact/factor/reference provenance; estimator_branch must equal the cell estimator
numeric_contract.contrast_variance_error: absolute(w^T production_operator w-w^T dense_oracle w)/max(abs(w^T dense_oracle w),1e-15); maximum 0.10
numeric_contract.empirical_covariance: population covariance sum(error outer error)/n - mean(error) outer mean(error), where error=(estimated_target-estimated_reference)-(latent_target-latent_reference); target/reference estimator errors are also cross-reduced and must have the preregistered signed-pair covariance
numeric_contract.predicted_covariance: mean of per-attempt production predicted target-minus-reference covariance; calibration error is Frobenius(mean_predicted-empirical)/max(Frobenius(empirical),1e-15); direct matched cells require positive < independent < negative for predicted and empirical traces
numeric_contract.coincident: identical support, raw source content, latent histories, estimated histories, and exact-zero predicted target-minus-reference covariance
numeric_contract.psd: minimum diagonal after independent cyclic Jacobi eigensolver on (M+M^T)/2; sweep p ascending then q ascending; tolerance 1e-14*max(1,max_abs_diagonal); at most 100*n*n sweeps; fail if not converged; compare to -1e-10
numeric_contract.interval_score: per non-gauge date, width+(2/0.05)*(absolute_error-half_width) when absolute_error exceeds half_width
numeric_contract.self_attested_metric_policy: no Rust metric or realized noisy truth is accepted; Python regenerates raw DGP and latent histories, validates estimator/covariance/operator/oracle/artifact digests, and derives operator error, contrast-variance error, signed target/reference error covariance, difference covariance calibration, PSD, intervals, and coverage
numeric_contract.canonical_hashes: SHA-256 over frozen streaming raw encoding and numeric encodings with domain tags raw-input-v4, source-raw-input-v4, latent-phase-history-v4, estimate-history-v4, predicted-difference-covariance-v4, production-operator-v4, dense-oracle-v4, mean-predicted-covariance-v4, empirical-error-covariance-v4

cell_reducers.attempted_seeds: exactly the preregistered per-cell fixed count: one deterministic edge seed or 5000 supported Monte Carlo seeds
cell_reducers.error_sum: bounded date vector sum over emitted valid difference errors
cell_reducers.error_outer_sum: bounded date-by-date sum of difference-error outer products over emitted valid attempts
cell_reducers.target_reference_error_sums: bounded target-error vector, reference-error vector, and target-by-reference outer-product matrix
cell_reducers.predicted_covariance_sum: bounded date-by-date sum over emitted valid attempts
cell_reducers.psd_min_eigenvalue: minimum over emitted predicted covariance attempts
cell_reducers.coverage_95_by_date: bounded count vector divided by emitted attempts; every non-gauge date independently must be within 0.02 of 0.95; acquisition zero is null
cell_reducers.final_date_coverage_95: explicit last element of coverage_95_by_date and independently gated
cell_reducers.interval_score_mean_by_date: bounded per-date sums divided by emitted attempts; acquisition zero is null
cell_reducers.interval_width_mean_by_date: bounded per-date sums divided by emitted attempts; acquisition zero is null
cell_reducers.final_date_interval_receipts: explicit last elements of per-date interval score and width
cell_reducers.retention: only sums, outer products, per-date count vectors, scalar extrema, artifact/factor digests, and streaming digests; no attempts
cell_reducers.masked: one deterministic masked_target contract; pass; zero emission; null estimator, operator, oracle, contrast, and covariance evidence
cell_reducers.not_evaluable: only tied_eigenvalue cells; one deterministic tied-eigenvalue contract

raw_proper_complex.temporal_signal: proper-complex AR(1), rho=exp(-cadence_days/correlation_days), innovations in acquisition order
raw_proper_complex.spatial_stress: signal and measurement-noise local/global proper-complex innovations mixed with weights sqrt(0.5); negative pairs use opposite global loadings on the target and reference sides of their midpoint; independent process uses local weight one
raw_proper_complex.sampler_seed: sha256(validation_seed||cell_id||seed_index||source_row,source_column); one separate global-source-process stream per cell attempt

full_replay_dgp.candidate_sources: complete contiguous row-major half-window with production inward clamping inside each 256 by 256 native tile, for target union reference before adaptive selection
full_replay_dgp.raw_shape: realized support union count by complete topology acquisition count by real/imag
full_replay_dgp.support_generation: run the frozen Rect, GLRT, or KS selector separately on every expected ministack real-acquisition slice; hashes bind ordered block_id and row-major realized sources
full_replay_dgp.ancestry: bind every expected ministack block, carried parent identity, complete date axis, acquisition-zero gauge, cap eviction, and partial tail
full_replay_dgp.latent_history: noiseless target/reference coordinate phase histories from the frozen phase formula, date cadence, pair orientation, and exact acquisition-zero gauge
full_replay_dgp.rust_output: actual EMI or EVD target/reference estimated histories plus predicted production target-minus-reference date covariance
full_replay_dgp.coincident: same realized support and raw source content, identical latent and estimated histories, exact zero predicted contrast covariance
full_replay_dgp.comparison: Python regenerates all content/support/ancestry/DGP/latent digests and derives estimator errors, empirical covariance, predicted covariance mean, PSD, intervals, and coverage

coordinates.realized_overlap: intersection_source_count/union_source_count (Jaccard) from exact target/reference support keys per attempt
coordinates.adaptive_supports: target and reference support hashes and counts vary by seed

signed_spatial_field.field: one cell-global proper-complex innovation with sqrt(0.5) magnitude
signed_spatial_field.pair_perturbation: positive pairs load every source +1; negative pairs load sources nearest target +1 and sources nearest reference -1 with target winning exact distance ties
signed_spatial_field.none: disjoint source-key cross term exact zero
signed_spatial_field.sign_field_identity: raw DGP hashes plus target/reference support hashes and independently reduced target/reference estimator-error cross covariance
signed_spatial_field.persist: signed_cross_influence, sign, target/reference loading means, and cross-error covariance trace

truth.latent: frozen noiseless target/reference phase histories regenerated independently from the DGP
truth.predicted_covariance: production target-minus-reference date covariance emitted by Rust without a noisy realized truth matrix
truth.coverage_event: latent target-minus-reference history lies inside each non-gauge date interval
truth.attempt_aggregation: bounded error sums, error outer-product sums, predicted covariance sums, counts, and digests only

resource_sampling.raw_measurement_binding: SHA-256 of canonical raw record containing exact child command, exit status, wall seconds, max RSS, sampler, tool outputs, OS, hardware, and benchmark-emitted allocation measurement for every repetition
resource_sampling.allocation_model: benchmark-emitted named-allocation-components-v1 with exact coefficient_bytes times ordered axis extents and recomputed component digest
resource_sampling.dependency_cone_binding: benchmark-emitted block count, maximum sources per block, dependency depth, and reference-cone sources plus canonical SHA-256
resource_sampling.area_axis_rule: each allocation component has at most one axis factor marked area_scaled; two area-scaled axes fail mechanically before RSS interpretation
resource_sampling.acceptance: benchmark-emitted dependency, persisted, scratch, final, microbatch and named allocation formulas pass; all measured repetitions <= rss threshold; both independently identifiable exponents <=1.25; RSS corroborates the bound

receipt_contract.masked_target_metrics: signed_cross_influence, estimator histories/covariance, operator/oracle matrices, and contrast weights are null with emitted=false and factor_emitted=false; full raw DGP content/support/ancestry, latent identities, and production artifact provenance remain required
receipt_contract.retention: only cell summaries with bounded sums/counts/per-date vectors/digests, shard manifests, run manifest, performance probe, bounded raw resource receipts, and resource aggregates; ephemeral attempt transport and preparation descriptors are durably deleted after verified commit
receipt_contract.verification: regenerate full raw DGP and latent histories for every attempt; compare exact shape/count/content/support/ancestry/latent identities; independently derive operator and contrast-variance errors, target/reference error cross covariance, empirical and predicted difference covariance, PSD, per-date intervals, per-date coverage, and summaries; bind production HDF5 v4 factor/artifact/reference provenance; reuse requires exact Rust replay
receipt_contract.manifest_read: bounded bytes are read once with pre/open/post identity checks, then both hashed and parsed from those exact accepted bytes
receipt_contract.resource_hash: sha256 canonical JSON of complete resource receipt excluding resource_hash; every raw benchmark allocation measurement, allocation model, dependency cone, microbatch, and component hash is independently recomputed
